# spot_autopilotnodepool Resource

The `autopilotnodepool` resource manages an Autopilot Node Pool within a cloudspace. Instead of naming a server class and hand-managing node count and bid, a tenant declares a capacity shape — a total vCPU target, a memory-to-vCPU ratio, and an hourly budget read as a bid ceiling. Spot packs that shape from the cheapest qualifying server classes as child spot node pools, and re-packs as nodes are won, lost, or preempted. Fulfillment is asynchronous: an apply returns once the pool is created; watch the `phase` and `managed_vcpus` attributes to track capacity as it is won.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Creates an autopilot node pool that fills 12 vCPUs of 4 GiB/vCPU capacity,
# never bidding more than 12.00 USD/hour. Spot picks the cheapest qualifying
# server classes and packs them to exactly the target.
resource "spot_autopilotnodepool" "example" {
  cloudspace_name = "example"
  # region is optional: it defaults to the referenced cloudspace's region.
  # Set it explicitly only if you need to pin it (it must match the cloudspace).
  vcpu = {
    total = 12
  }
  memory_per_vcpu = "4"
  budget_per_hour = "12.00"

  # Optional: bound the size of each individual node.
  # vcpu_per_node = {
  #   min = 4
  #   max = 8
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `budget_per_hour` (String) Hourly budget (USD), read as a bid ceiling. Positive, up to three decimal places.
- `cloudspace_name` (String) The name of the cloudspace the resulting nodes join.
- `vcpu` (Attributes) Total vCPU target Spot fills exactly via a combination pack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vcpu))

### Optional

- `allocation_strategy` (String) How eligible server classes are ranked. Only LowestPrice is accepted.
- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations to be applied to the nodes of the node pool
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels to be applied to the nodes of the node pool
- `memory_per_vcpu` (String) Required memory-to-vCPU ratio in GB: any, 2, 4, or 8. Defaults to any.
- `region` (String) Region whose server classes are eligible for this autopilot pool. Defaults to the referenced cloudspace's region when omitted. Immutable.
- `taints` (Attributes List) Kubernetes taints to be applied to the nodes of the node pool (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--taints))
- `vcpu_per_node` (Attributes) Optionally bounds the size of each individual node/server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vcpu_per_node))

### Read-Only

- `allocations` (Attributes List) Per-server-class allocation breakdown. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocations))
- `id` (String, Deprecated) The id of the autopilotnodepool.
- `last_updated` (String) The last time the autopilotnodepool was updated.
- `managed_memory_gb` (String) Total memory (GB) currently won across child pools.
- `managed_vcpus` (Number) Total vCPUs currently won across child pools.
- `name` (String) The name of the autopilotnodepool.
- `phase` (String) Fulfillment phase of the autopilot pool.
- `target_vcpus` (Number) vCPU count Spot is filling (== vcpu.total).

<a id="nestedatt--vcpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcpu`

Required:

- `total` (Number) Total vCPUs to fill (a positive multiple of the smallest usable node).


<a id="nestedatt--taints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `taints`

Required:

- `effect` (String) The taint effect (NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule, or NoExecute)
- `key` (String) The taint key to be applied

Optional:

- `value` (String) The taint value


<a id="nestedatt--vcpu_per_node"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcpu_per_node`

Optional:

- `max` (Number) Maximum vCPUs per node.
- `min` (Number) Minimum vCPUs per node.


<a id="nestedatt--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocations`

Read-Only:

- `bid_price_per_hour` (String) Bid price per hour (USD) placed for this class.
- `desired_nodes` (Number) Desired node count for this allocation.
- `market_price_per_hour` (String) Market clearing price per hour (USD) for this class.
- `memory_gb_per_node` (String) Memory (GB) per node for this class.
- `server_class` (String) The server class fulfilling this allocation.
- `spot_node_pool` (String) Name of the child SpotNodePool fulfilling this allocation.
- `vcpu_per_node` (Number) vCPUs per node for this class.
- `won_nodes` (Number) Won node count for this allocation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An autopilot node pool can be imported by specifying its name (a UUID).
terraform import spot_autopilotnodepool.example c126b90d-00d1-48fb-92ae-b8c88e27f511
```
